dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've actually been to those places. All of them.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: Then you are truly fortunate — a brave and wise adventurer, no doubt.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: But there are many who will never leave Snezhnaya in their entire lives.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: Perhaps what I sell are only ordinary trinkets, but for them, it may be the fastest way to glimpse a foreign world.
